$comment: Rule 6: prices are configuration. The length ladder was set 2026-09-30 (docs/decisions.md D15). D19 (2026-10-01) turns on paid purchase: 4-char names sell for $5 and the second+ long name per wallet for $1, paid in USDG. Tiers 1-3 stay project-reserved (quotePurchase returns null below 4 units). The registrar contract never touches money: buyers pay the treasury direct and the API verifies the Transfer before sponsoring.
$comment_units: All length thresholds use limits.lengthMetric (default: display width, so one CJK character counts as two).
$comment_ladder: A name is priced by how few characters it has, because that is what makes it worth remembering. The first name of five characters or more is free (invitation-gated, D17) — that promise is what the product is built on and it does not change. What costs money is being short, and taking more names than the free one.

premiumTiers.$comment: Not sellable yet (D19): opens only after 50+ tier-4 sales are reviewed.

purchase.$comment: Flip to true in the same push that deploys the purchase API (D19). token = canonical USDG verified on docs.robinhood.com/chain/contracts and re-checked via RPC (symbol USDG, decimals 6). treasury is receive-only; the key lives in .secrets/treasury.txt and never on the server.

additionalName.$comment: Beyond the one free name per wallet, a longer name is one dollar (D19).
